units.source_excerpt: The Summary Sheet compresses parameters, network concepts, Voronoi and extremal optimization, 104-versus-108 placement figures, probabilistic reachability, and stated strengths and weaknesses into a one-page decision overview.
units.function: State the decision constraints, name the computational mechanism, report the result, and retain its scope.
units.reusable_pattern: constraints -> method -> quantitative result -> scope
prohibited_generalizations: Do not copy radio frequencies, distances, population counts, target ratios, pseudocode, result counts, or source sentences into another paper.
